name: Groundnut Oil
shortDescription: Fresh cold-pressed groundnut oil with rich aroma and natural taste for daily cooking.
description: Traditionally processed groundnut oil cold-pressed to retain all natural goodness. Free from additives, palm oil, and preservatives. Rich in natural nutrients with authentic aroma every family loves.

name: Sesame Oil
shortDescription: Pure sesame oil extracted using traditional wooden ghani press with natural aroma.
description: Our sesame oil is extracted using a traditional wooden press (ghani) method to preserve natural aroma and nutritional value. Rich in antioxidants and perfect for South Indian cooking.

name: Coconut Oil
shortDescription: Pure cold-pressed coconut oil for cooking, hair care, and skin care.
description: Cold-pressed pure coconut oil made from fresh coconuts with no chemicals or additives. Solidifies naturally in cool temperatures — a true sign of purity. Multi-purpose oil for cooking, hair, and skin.

name: Mustard Oil
shortDescription: Kachi Ghani mustard oil with strong natural aroma perfect for pickles and cooking.
description: Kachi Ghani mustard oil with strong, pungent natural aroma. Perfect for pickles, cooking, and traditional recipes. Pressed from quality mustard seeds using traditional methods.

name: Castor Oil
shortDescription: Natural castor oil cold-pressed for hair growth, skin care, and traditional use.
description: Pure castor oil cold-pressed from quality castor seeds. Known for its thick consistency and immense benefits for hair growth, skin, and traditional medicinal use.

name: Sunflower Oil
shortDescription: Light and healthy sunflower oil for everyday cooking.
description: Premium quality sunflower oil with light texture and neutral flavor. Low in saturated fats and ideal for daily cooking, baking, and frying.

name: Rice Bran Oil
shortDescription: Healthy rice bran oil with high smoke point for high-temperature cooking.
description: Premium rice bran oil extracted from the outer layer of rice. High smoke point makes it ideal for high-temperature cooking. Rich in Vitamin E and antioxidants.

name: Jonna Idly
shortDescription: Soft and healthy Jonna (Sorghum) Idly — a nutritious traditional millet breakfast.
description: Freshly made Jonna Idly using sorghum millet batter. A traditional Andhra breakfast that is rich in fibre, gluten-free, and ideal for all ages including diabetics.

name: Millet Dosa
shortDescription: Crispy millet dosa — traditional, healthy, and gluten-free.
description: Millet Dosa made from a blend of healthy millets. Crispy, light, and packed with nutrients. A great alternative to regular rice dosa for health-conscious families.

name: Ragi Idly
shortDescription: Soft Ragi (Finger Millet) Idly — calcium-rich and traditionally made.
description: Ragi Idly made with finger millet, the highest source of natural calcium among grains. Soft, nutritious, and ideal for children and growing families.

name: Vegetable Idly
shortDescription: Colourful vegetable idly packed with nutrition and natural goodness.
description: Soft idly stuffed with fresh vegetables and traditional spices. Made with natural colours from vegetables only — no artificial colours. A wholesome breakfast for the whole family.

name: Chegodi
shortDescription: Crispy traditional Chegodi rings made in pure oil — a classic Andhra snack.
description: Chegodi is a classic Andhra snack made with rice flour, sesame seeds, and mild spices. Fried in pure groundnut oil for authentic taste and long-lasting crunch.

name: Janthikalu
shortDescription: Traditional Janthikalu made with rice flour and fresh spices — crispy and flavourful.
description: Janthikalu are spiral-shaped rice flour snacks deep-fried in pure oil. A popular Andhra festival snack made fresh in small batches with no artificial flavours.

name: Jonna Chekkalu
shortDescription: Crispy Jonna (Jowar) Chekkalu — a healthy millet-based traditional snack.
description: Jonna Chekkalu are rice crackers made with jowar (sorghum) flour. A healthier take on the traditional chekkalu snack, rich in fibre and made in pure oil.

name: Boondi Mixture
shortDescription: Crunchy Boondi Mixture with a perfect blend of spices and freshness.
description: Our Boondi Mixture is made fresh with crunchy boondi, peanuts, curry leaves, and spices. Fried in pure groundnut oil with no artificial flavours or colourings.

name: Chekkalu
shortDescription: Classic rice crackers (Chekkalu) made with sesame seeds and pure oil.
description: Chekkalu are traditional rice flour crackers with sesame seeds and spices. Crispy, light, and freshly made in pure groundnut oil. A timeless Andhra snack for all occasions.

name: Karam Poosa
shortDescription: Spicy and crispy Karam Poosa — a beloved Andhra tea-time snack.
description: Karam Poosa is a spicy gram flour-based snack made with fresh green chillies, curry leaves, and spices. Fried in pure oil for an authentic, addictive crunch.

name: Sakinalu
shortDescription: Traditional Sakinalu — a festive Sankranti snack made with sesame and rice flour.
description: Sakinalu are handmade festive snacks made with rice flour and sesame seeds. A traditional Sankranti special from Andhra Pradesh, fried in pure oil to golden perfection.

name: Coconut Chutney
shortDescription: Freshly made coconut chutney — smooth, aromatic, and traditionally prepared.
description: Our Coconut Chutney is made fresh from grated coconut, roasted gram, and traditional tempering. No vinegar, no artificial flavours — just pure, authentic taste.

name: Ginger Chutney
shortDescription: Tangy Ginger (Allam) Chutney made with fresh ginger and traditional spices.
description: Allam Chutney is made from fresh ginger, tamarind, and jaggery in perfect balance. Pairs beautifully with idly, dosa, and pesarattu. A digestive-friendly chutney loved across Telugu households.

name: Coriander Chutney
shortDescription: Fresh coriander chutney bursting with natural flavour and green goodness.
description: Fresh coriander leaves blended with green chillies, lemon, and spices to create this vibrant chutney. No artificial colour — the natural green colour comes from fresh coriander.

name: Tomato Chutney
shortDescription: Tangy and spicy homemade tomato chutney — perfect with idly and dosa.
description: Made from fresh ripe tomatoes, onions, and traditional spices. This tangy chutney is a household favourite across South India. No artificial colour, no vinegar.

name: Onion Gongura Chutney
shortDescription: Classic Andhra-style Onion Gongura Chutney with authentic tangy flavour.
description: Gongura (sorrel leaves) combined with fresh onions and traditional spices create this iconic Andhra chutney. Tangy, spicy, and packed with iron and vitamins.

name: Green Chilli Chutney
shortDescription: Fiery green chilli chutney for those who love bold, spicy flavours.
description: Fresh green chillies tempered with mustard seeds, curry leaves, and spices. Bold, hot, and flavourful — this chutney adds a punch to any meal. Naturally coloured from fresh chillies.

name: Idly Podi
shortDescription: Freshly ground Idly Podi with aromatic lentils and spices — best with ghee.
description: Our Idly Podi is made fresh from roasted urad dal, chana dal, sesame seeds, and red chillies. Freshly stone-ground for maximum aroma. Best enjoyed mixed with sesame oil or ghee.

name: Dosa Podi
shortDescription: Spicy and aromatic Dosa Podi — ideal sprinkled over crispy hot dosa.
description: Dosa Podi is freshly made from roasted lentils, sesame, and red chillies ground to a coarse powder. Sprinkle over dosa with a drizzle of sesame oil for a complete Andhra breakfast.

name: Dhaniyala Podi
shortDescription: Freshly ground coriander seed podi with warm earthy flavour.
description: Dhaniyala Podi is made from freshly roasted and stone-ground coriander seeds. Adds depth and warmth to chutneys, gravies, and rice dishes. Pure spice with no fillers.

name: Kothimeera Podi
shortDescription: Aromatic dry coriander leaf powder — a versatile everyday kitchen spice.
description: Kothimeera Podi is made from dried fresh coriander leaves blended with traditional spices. Adds a fresh herbaceous note to dal, rice, and gravies. Stone-ground for authentic texture.

name: Munagaku Podi
shortDescription: Nutritious drumstick leaf (Moringa) powder — a natural health supplement.
description: Munagaku Podi is made from dried moringa leaves rich in iron, calcium, and vitamins. A traditional Andhra health food that can be mixed with rice or used as a seasoning.

name: Karakkaya Podi
shortDescription: Traditional Karakkaya (Chebulic Myrobalan) podi — digestive and medicinal.
description: Karakkaya Podi is made from sun-dried Chebulic Myrobalan (Haritaki) — an Ayurvedic ingredient known for digestive benefits. Stone-ground fresh for maximum potency.

name: Pesara Podi
shortDescription: Freshly ground green gram (Pesara) podi — protein-rich and delicious.
description: Pesara Podi is made from roasted green gram (moong dal) with traditional spices. Rich in protein and easy to digest. Mix with hot rice and ghee for a simple nutritious meal.

name: Nuvvula Podi
shortDescription: Sesame seed podi with rich nutty flavour — calcium-rich and tasty.
description: Nuvvula Podi is made from roasted sesame seeds ground with spices. Rich in calcium and healthy fats. Perfect with hot rice and ghee, or as a topping on dosa and idly.

name: Sonthi Podi
shortDescription: Warming dry ginger powder — used in cooking and as a natural remedy.
description: Sonthi Podi is made from sun-dried ginger root ground to a fine powder. Used in Andhra cooking for warmth and flavour, and traditionally consumed for digestion and immunity.

name: Miriyala Podi
shortDescription: Freshly ground black pepper powder with sharp, bold flavour.
description: Miriyala Podi is freshly stone-ground black pepper powder with bold, sharp flavour. Used in Andhra rasam, curries, and as a table spice. Pure pepper with no fillers or additives.

name: Sambar Podi
shortDescription: Aromatic homemade sambar podi ground fresh with traditional spice blends.
description: Our Sambar Podi is made from a traditional blend of coriander, cumin, red chillies, and other aromatic spices. Freshly roasted and stone-ground for deep, complex flavour in every pot.

name: Garlic Powder
shortDescription: Pure garlic powder with bold flavour — no fillers, just pure garlic.
description: Made from sun-dried garlic cloves ground to a fine powder. Intense garlic flavour for use in masalas, marinades, and everyday cooking. Pure and unadulterated.

name: Masala Powder
shortDescription: Freshly blended traditional masala powder for curries and gravies.
description: Our Masala Powder is a blend of whole spices freshly roasted and ground. Each batch is prepared traditionally to ensure consistent depth of flavour in your everyday curries.

name: Mango Pickle
shortDescription: Traditional Andhra mango pickle made in pure sesame oil with bold spices.
description: Classic Avakaya — Andhra-style raw mango pickle made with freshly ground spices and pure sesame oil. No vinegar, no preservatives. Matures to perfection in traditional clay jars.

name: Magaya
shortDescription: Magaya — raw mango pickle with fenugreek and traditional Andhra spices.
description: Magaya is a unique Andhra-style raw mango pickle made with tender mango pieces, fenugreek seeds, and bold spices. Distinct from avakaya with its own deep, rich flavour profile.

name: Tomato Pickle
shortDescription: Tangy homemade tomato pickle with fresh tomatoes and traditional spices.
description: Made from fresh ripe tomatoes slow-cooked with spices and sesame oil. Tangy, spicy, and utterly addictive. No artificial colour — the vibrant red colour comes naturally from tomatoes.

name: Pandu Mirchi Pickle
shortDescription: Fiery red chilli pickle — bold, spicy, and made the traditional Andhra way.
description: Pandu Mirchi Pickle is made from ripe red chillies in pure sesame oil. Intensely spicy and deeply flavourful. A staple in Andhra households that complements every meal.

name: Usirikaya Pickle
shortDescription: Vitamin C-rich Amla (Usirikaya) pickle in traditional Andhra style.
description: Usirikaya (Indian Gooseberry / Amla) pickle made with pure sesame oil and traditional spices. Rich in Vitamin C and antioxidants. A tangy and healthy Andhra favourite.

name: Chintakaya Pickle
shortDescription: Traditional tamarind (Chintakaya) pickle with a sharp tangy flavour.
description: Chintakaya Pickle is made from young tamarind pods cooked with spices and sesame oil. Sharp, tangy, and intensely flavourful — a traditional delicacy in Andhra kitchens.

name: Sweet Avakaya
shortDescription: Sweet and spicy mango pickle — the milder, jaggery-sweetened Avakaya version.
description: Sweet Avakaya uses raw mango, jaggery, and mild spices for a unique sweet-spicy balance. Sweeter than traditional avakaya, it is popular with children and those preferring mild taste.

name: Gongura Pickle
shortDescription: The iconic Andhra Gongura Pickle — tangy sorrel leaves in pure oil.
description: Gongura Pickle is the crown jewel of Andhra cuisine. Made from sorrel leaves with pure sesame oil and bold spices. Intensely tangy, rich in iron, and deeply satisfying.

name: Dabbakaya Pickle
shortDescription: Tangy citrus (Dabbakaya) pickle with a unique fresh citrus flavour.
description: Dabbakaya Pickle is made from citron fruit (rough lemon) in pure sesame oil with traditional spices. Unique citrusy tanginess distinct from regular lemon pickle.

name: Ginger Pickle
shortDescription: Spicy and warming ginger pickle — a digestive and flavourful Andhra condiment.
description: Allam (Ginger) Pickle made from fresh ginger cooked down with sesame oil, tamarind, and spices. Warming, tangy, and with excellent digestive properties.

name: Turmeric Powder
shortDescription: Pure, vibrant turmeric powder freshly ground from quality turmeric roots.
description: Our Turmeric Powder is ground from high-quality, vibrant yellow turmeric roots. Pure and unadulterated — no artificial colour, no fillers. Rich in curcumin for health benefits.

name: Kumkum
shortDescription: Pure traditional Kumkum made from natural ingredients for daily puja use.
description: Traditional Kumkum made from naturally processed turmeric with lime — following age-old preparation methods. Pure, vibrant, and safe for daily religious use.

name: Fenugreek Powder
shortDescription: Pure fenugreek (Menthi) powder — a natural health staple in Indian cooking.
description: Freshly roasted and stone-ground fenugreek seeds. Used in cooking, hair care, and as a natural health supplement. Mildly bitter with warming properties.

name: Coriander Powder
shortDescription: Freshly ground coriander powder with warm, earthy aroma.
description: Our Coriander Powder is made from freshly roasted coriander seeds stone-ground to a fine powder. Warm, earthy, and aromatic — essential in every Indian kitchen.

name: Cold Pressed Oil
shortDescription: Traditional cold pressed oil extracted without heat to preserve natural nutrients.
description: Cold Pressed Oil extracted using traditional methods without heat treatment. This preserves natural antioxidants, vitamins, and original flavour. Available in groundnut, sesame, and coconut varieties.

name: Pappu Nune
shortDescription: Traditional Pappu Nune — a pure and nutritious seed butter used in Andhra cooking.
description: Pappu Nune is a traditional Andhra ingredient made from ground lentils or seeds in oil. Rich, flavourful, and used as a cooking base or condiment in traditional recipes.

name: Ulava Pindi
shortDescription: Freshly ground horse gram flour — a protein-rich traditional Andhra ingredient.
description: Ulava Pindi is freshly ground horse gram flour. Rich in protein and used in traditional Andhra dishes like Ulava Charu (horse gram rasam). Stone-ground fresh for best nutritional value.

name: Minapappu Podi
shortDescription: Freshly ground black gram (Urad dal) powder — essential for South Indian cooking.
description: Minapappu Podi is freshly ground urad dal flour used in idly, dosa batters, and traditional vadas. Stone-ground for authentic texture and binding properties.

name: Ravva Dosa Mix
shortDescription: Ready-to-use Ravva Dosa mix for instant crispy dosas — just add water.
description: Our Ravva Dosa Mix is a traditional blend of semolina, rice flour, and spices. Just add water and rest for 15 minutes for instant crispy, lacy Rava Dosa at home.

name: Sanaga Pindi
shortDescription: Pure besan (chana dal) flour freshly ground for snacks, sweets, and cooking.
description: Sanaga Pindi is freshly stone-ground besan (chickpea flour) from quality chana dal. Perfect for pakodas, laddu, snack batters, and traditional Andhra sweets.

name: Barley Powder
shortDescription: Nutritious barley powder for healthy drinks, porridge, and cooking.
description: Barley Powder is made from roasted barley grain ground to a smooth powder. Rich in beta-glucan fibre, ideal for cholesterol management and digestive health. Great in warm drinks and porridge.

name: Pesara Pappu Mix
shortDescription: Ready-to-cook Pesara Pappu (green gram) mix for quick nutritious meals.
description: Pesara Pappu Mix is a blend of green gram and traditional spices for quick, nutritious green gram curry. High in protein and easy to cook in minutes. No artificial additives.
